page.name: Page
rules: White sections on the paper page; ink text in Inter at 16px.
Blue is a ground (the hero, a panel, the footer) and the color of actions and labels; never a gradient behind text.

column.name: Content column
rules: Content sits in a 1200px column with at least 40px of gutter (20px on phones).
Reading text, forms and FAQ lists narrow to 680px (--ds-layout-text).

section.name: Section
rules: White sections, 80px above and about 110px below; 50px and 65px on phones.
A section on the blue ground is a deliberate band (the hero, a closing panel): white type, the white key, sky labels.

section-heading.name: Section heading
section-heading.tailwind: font-display text-h2 font-medium tracking-tighter leading-display text-fg text-center text-balance
rules: Centered, display face at 500, 36px (28px on phones), tracked tight.
The description sits under it, centered, at 19px and 70 percent ink.
The page title of an inner page (Pricing, About) is the 52px step (h1).

section-description.name: Section description
section-description.tailwind: max-w-(--ds-layout-heading) mx-auto text-body-lg leading-snug tracking-tight text-fg-muted text-center
rules: 19px Inter at 70 percent ink, centered under the heading, 14px below it.
One or two lines; never wider than about 670px.

hero.name: Hero
rules: The blue ground, full bleed: white type, the white key as the main action.
Add data-ds-hero to the hero section: it gives the blue ground and the four stepped bands into the white page below.
Its imagery stays the site's own; nothing is added behind the headline.

hero-title.name: Hero title
hero-title.tailwind: font-display text-hero font-medium tracking-display leading-tight text-balance
rules: 72px display at 500, tracked to -0.055em, leading 1; 40px on phones.
White on the blue hero; ink on a white page (an inner page title is 52px).

hero-subtitle.name: Hero subtitle
rules: 19px Inter, white at 72 percent on the blue (70 percent ink on white).
One line where it fits.

eyebrow.name: Eyebrow
rules: 12px display face in blue (sky on the blue ground), sentence case, never caps.
Above a page title or a section group: "The company", "Team".

card.name: Card
card.tailwind: flex flex-col gap-3 p-6 border border-hairline rounded-card bg-surface shadow-card
rules: White, a 16 percent ink hairline, 12px corners and a soft drop under a light inner top.
A card that names an app or a file wears a window bar on top (window).
The large product cards are the raised card: 20px corners and a hard 7px offset shadow.

card-raised.name: Raised card
card-raised.tailwind: p-3 border border-hairline rounded-shell bg-surface shadow-raised
rules: The product card: 20px corners, a 12px inset frame around its media, and a hard 7px offset shadow at 10 percent ink.
Copy sits beside or under the media: a 36px title, a 19px line at 60 percent, then the blue key.

window.name: Window
window.tailwind: overflow-hidden border border-hairline rounded-card bg-surface shadow-card
rules: A card with a 32px title bar: an arrow mark, a file-like name (pricing.plan, team.dir) and [*] at the right.
The bar is sky with blue marks; the one window that matters most gets the blue bar with white marks.

window-bar.name: Window bar
window-bar.tailwind: flex items-center justify-between gap-3 min-h-8 px-2.5 border-b border-line-window bg-window-bar text-window-bar-fg font-display text-micro
rules: 32px, sky ground, blue marks in the 10px display face, a 25 percent blue line under it.
Left: the arrow and the window's name; right: [*]. On the featured window: blue ground, white marks.

card-title.name: Card title
card-title.tailwind: font-display text-h3 font-medium tracking-tight leading-display text-fg
rules: 24px display at 500, tracked tight. A product card's title is the 36px step at 400.
Its description is 14px Inter at 68 percent ink.

body-text.name: Body text
rules: 16px Inter, leading 1.6, ink. A lead paragraph is 19px.
Lines no wider than about 70 characters.

caption.name: Caption
rules: 14px Inter at 68 percent ink: card descriptions, list details, small print.

link.name: Link

css.transition: color var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out), text-decoration-color var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out)

link.tailwind: underline decoration-brand underline-offset-[0.2em] transition-colors duration-150 ease-out hover:text-fg-brand
rules: Inline links keep the text color with a blue underline; hover turns the text blue.
Navigation and footer links have no underline.

button-primary.name: Primary button

css.transition: background-color var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out), color var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out), box-shadow var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out), transform var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out)

button-primary.tailwind: inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2.5 h-10 px-5 rounded-control border border-line-brand-edge bg-primary text-on-primary font-display text-body-sm font-normal leading-none whitespace-nowrap shadow-key-brand transition-[background-color,color,box-shadow,transform] duration-150 ease-out hover:bg-primary-hover active:translate-y-px active:shadow-pressed
rules: The blue key: 40px tall, 8px corners, 14px display face, a border a shade darker than the fill, a light inner top, a darker inner bottom and a soft blue drop.
Hover lightens a shade; a press sinks it 1px and swaps the shadow for the pressed well.
On the blue ground the main action is the white key (button-on-brand).

button-secondary.name: Secondary button

css.transition: background-color var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out), color var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out), box-shadow var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out), transform var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out)

button-secondary.tailwind: inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2.5 h-10 px-5 rounded-control border border-hairline bg-surface text-fg font-display text-body-sm font-normal leading-none whitespace-nowrap shadow-key transition-[background-color,color,box-shadow,transform] duration-150 ease-out hover:bg-sky-wash active:translate-y-px active:shadow-pressed
rules: The white key on white: ink text, a 16 percent ink border and the same bevel in gray.
Hover warms to the pale sky; a press sinks it.

button-on-brand.name: Button on the blue

css.transition: background-color var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out), color var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out), box-shadow var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out), transform var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out)

button-on-brand.tailwind: inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2.5 h-10 px-5 rounded-control border border-hairline bg-white text-fg-brand font-display text-body-sm font-normal leading-none whitespace-nowrap shadow-key transition-[background-color,color,box-shadow,transform] duration-150 ease-out hover:bg-sky-wash active:translate-y-px active:shadow-pressed
rules: The white key with blue text: the main action on the blue ground (the hero, the footer, a blue panel).
Hover warms to the pale sky; a press sinks it.

header.name: Header
rules: A bare bar: the wordmark at the left, one Get started key at the right, 20px from the top; no background, no rule.
Over the blue hero its marks are white and its key is the white key; on a white page the wordmark is blue.

header-action.name: Header action

css.transition: background-color var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out), color var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out), box-shadow var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out), transform var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out)

header-action.tailwind: inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2.5 h-10 px-5 rounded-control border border-hairline bg-white text-fg-brand font-display text-body-sm font-medium leading-none whitespace-nowrap shadow-key transition-[background-color,color,box-shadow,transform] duration-150 ease-out hover:bg-sky-wash active:translate-y-px active:shadow-pressed
rules: The header's one action is the white key with blue text at 500, on the blue hero and on white alike.
Other header links are nav links.

nav-link.name: Nav link

css.transition: background-color var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out), color var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out)

nav-link.tailwind: flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-sm font-display text-body-sm leading-none text-inherit transition-colors duration-150 ease-out hover:bg-wash-hover aria-[current=page]:bg-white aria-[current=page]:text-fg-brand aria-[current=page]:shadow-key
rules: 14px display face in a 6px-cornered key; hover is a light wash.
The current page is the white key with blue text, as in the brand's dock.

nav-dock.name: Glass nav
nav-dock.tailwind: p-[3px] border border-line-on-brand rounded-control bg-glass bg-(image:--ds-glass-sheen) shadow-floating [backdrop-filter:var(--ds-glass-blur)] text-white font-display text-body-sm
rules: A floating bar of glass: ink at 42 percent under a light sheen, blurred, 8px corners, white marks.
Its links are nav links; the current one is the white key.

chip.name: Tag
chip.tailwind: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 border border-line-brand rounded-none text-fg-brand font-display text-micro tracking-caps uppercase leading-[1.75]
rules: A small tag: 10px display caps tracked wide, blue on white with a blue border and square corners (Added, Fixed, New).
Tags are the one place type is set in caps.

stat.name: Stat
stat.tailwind: font-display text-h2 font-medium tracking-tight leading-tight tabular-nums
rules: A figure in the 36px display step at 500 (a price, a count), its unit beside it in 14px Inter.

code-window.name: Code window
code-window.tailwind: overflow-hidden rounded-control bg-code text-fg-on-brand-muted font-mono text-caption leading-[1.55] shadow-code
rules: Ink ground, 8px corners, code in the 12px display face at 88 percent white, a deep drop under it.
A code window usually sits on a blue panel (media-frame).

media-frame.name: Media panel
rules: Screens, code and demos sit on a blue panel with 12px corners and 32px of padding.
Phone screens and app windows inside it keep their own look.

table.name: Table
rules: 14px Inter rows with a 14 percent ink rule under each; headers in the 12px display face at 68 percent ink.
No zebra stripes, no vertical rules.

faq.name: FAQ
faq.tailwind: border-b border-line font-display text-body-sm font-medium tracking-[-0.01em]
rules: Questions in a 680px list: 14px display at 500, a 14 percent rule between, a drawn + that turns to an x when open.
The answer is 14px Inter at 68 percent ink, sliding open in 200ms.
On the brand's page the list sits in a window with topic tabs above it.

tabs.name: Tabs
tabs.tailwind: grid grid-flow-col auto-cols-fr gap-1 p-1 border border-hairline rounded-card bg-subtle shadow-well
rules: A sunken track (12px corners, 4px inset) of equal 40px tabs in the 14px display face.
The selected tab is the blue key with white text, and the key glides between tabs (260ms, in-out).

input.name: Input
input.tailwind: px-3 py-2.5 border border-line-strong rounded-none bg-surface text-fg font-sans text-h5 leading-snug outline-none focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-solid focus-visible:outline-focus-ring aria-invalid:border-danger
rules: Square fields: a 35 percent ink border, no corners, 18px Inter, 10px by 12px padding.
Focus draws a 2px blue outline just inside the edge. Labels use the 12px display face above the control; invalid fields use the danger border.

logo-strip.name: Merchant line
rules: A running line of names between two rules, separated by a small star; on the blue footer, white with 45 percent white rules.
Logos in a grid sit in small white windows, one pale tint per bar.

footer.name: Footer
rules: The blue ground, after four stepped bands from the white page above.
The wordmark in white, its line in 14px; link columns in the 12px display face, headings in sky, links white.
It may end with the striped wordmark across the full width.

menu-panel.name: Menu panel
menu-panel.tailwind: rounded-control border border-hairline bg-surface p-1 font-display text-body-sm text-fg shadow-tooltip outline-none
rules: Use the floating panel and display labels; keep the existing interaction and placement.
Menus keep keyboard focus, disabled states, and selection behavior.

menu-item.name: Menu item
menu-item.tailwind: rounded-menu px-2.5 py-2 font-display text-body-sm leading-snug text-fg-secondary outline-none data-[disabled]:pointer-events-none data-[disabled]:opacity-40 data-[highlighted]:bg-wash-hover data-[highlighted]:text-fg
rules: Use the floating panel and display labels; keep the existing interaction and placement.
Menus keep keyboard focus, disabled states, and selection behavior.

glass-menu.name: Glass menu
glass-menu.tailwind: rounded-control border border-line-on-brand bg-glass bg-(image:--ds-glass-sheen) p-1 font-display text-body-sm text-on-brand shadow-floating [backdrop-filter:var(--ds-glass-blur)] outline-none
rules: Use the floating panel and display labels; keep the existing interaction and placement.
Glass rows use the dock’s lit hover edge and white text.

glass-menu-item.name: Glass menu item
glass-menu-item.tailwind: rounded-sm px-2.75 py-3 font-display text-caption leading-none text-on-brand outline-none data-[highlighted]:bg-wash-glass-hover data-[highlighted]:shadow-glass-hover
rules: Use the floating panel and display labels; keep the existing interaction and placement.
Glass rows use the dock’s lit hover edge and white text.

popover-panel.name: Popover panel
popover-panel.tailwind: rounded-control border border-hairline bg-surface p-4 font-sans text-body-sm text-fg shadow-tooltip outline-none
rules: Use the floating panel and display labels; keep the existing interaction and placement.
Menus keep keyboard focus, disabled states, and selection behavior.
